template: California Tenant Protection Act statewide rent cap (Civil Code 1947.12) does not govern this address because a local rule (r-D008-01) governs instead of it. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 (added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 290, Sec. 4 (SB 567)); as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
